FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Missouri fishing licence

Anglers aged 16 or older generally need a fishing permit. Children and exempt seniors can still need a trout permit or a daily trout-park tag.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers aged 16 or older, unless permit-exempt.

Who doesn’t

  • Children aged 15 or younger; trout permits and tags can still apply.
  • Missouri residents aged 65 or older; trout requirements remain.
  • Free fishing days in 2026: June 6–7.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Daily fishing permitany1 day; multiple days available$9 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Non-resident trout permit · $24 USD
    Required to possess trout outside trout parks, for winter trout-park fishing, and all fishing in upper Lake Taneycomo.
  • Daily trout-park tag
    Required in trout parks when the daily-tag rules apply.

Rules visitors should know

  • Upper Lake Taneycomo requires a trout permit even without trout harvest.
  • A general permit exemption does not remove required trout permits or tags.

How to buy

Use the Buy Permit link on the department's permit page.
